title: Build and test baseline discovery
original_request: Execute the matching task in docs/agent-execution/13_TASK_GRAPH.md; preserve scope and report evidence.
goal: Discover build/test/lint/typecheck commands from actual CI, manifests, scripts, and docs.
Run only safe, project-documented checks after reviewing scripts and dependencies.
non_goals: Do not install opaque dependencies or run unknown postinstall scripts without review.
Do not modify source or test oracles.
constraints: Read-only discovery. Do not mutate repository source or GitHub settings.
Do not expose or reuse credentials previously disclosed in chat.
Record source, timestamp, commit, and method for every material claim.

assumptions.text: polymath-os is the intended target repository

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each command is traceable to a repository source
Every executed check has environment, command and exit code

acceptance_criteria.verification: Compare discovered commands against execution record.
